import sys,pathlib,json,copy
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import uuid4
w=pathlib.Path('/home/kali/.hermes/cache/scratch/omnis-p2-bound-predicates')
sys.path[:0]=[str(w/'api/src'),str(w/'api/tests'),str(w/'integrations/hermes/src'),str(w/'integrations/hermes/tests'),str(w/'integrations/hermes/upstream/managed-source')]
from test_contract_method_checks import native_case
from omnis.modules.settings.catalog_schema import canonical
from composition_fixture import seal
from contract_method_native_probe import ContractNative
from omnis_hermes.contract_method import assignment
from agent.contract_execution import ContractState,run_contract
from agent.cold_admission import ColdState
results=[]
for current in (True,False):
 case=native_case(predicates=current)
 for compact in (False,True):
  stage=copy.deepcopy(case.stage)
  if compact: ContractNative.compact(SimpleNamespace(payload=stage))
  brief,bound,material=assignment(canonical(stage))
  binding=copy.deepcopy(case.binding); body=binding['payload']
  entry={k:v for k,v in stage['manifest']['payload']['entries'][0].items() if k!='goal'}
  child=body['entries'][0]['native_child_id']; session=body['entries'][0]['native_session_id']
  entry.update(native_child_id=child,native_session_id=session); body['entries']=[entry]; seal(binding)
  root_session=str(uuid4()); root_id=body['native_root_id']
  parent=SimpleNamespace(session_id=root_session,_subagent_id=root_id,_cold_state=ColdState(root_session,root_id,None))
  state=ContractState(session,child,root_session,parent,canonical(stage),canonical(stage['manifest']),brief['payload']['deadline'])
  agent=SimpleNamespace(_contract_state=state,session_id=session,_subagent_id=child,_parent_session_id=root_session)
  counts={'reads':0,'pure':0,'task_result':0}
  def observe(frame,event,arg):
   if event=='call':
    name=frame.f_code.co_name
    if name=='_read_bound_input': counts['reads']+=1
    elif name=='run_handler': counts['pure']+=1
    elif name=='task_result': counts['task_result']+=1
  prior=sys.getprofile(); sys.setprofile(observe)
  try:
   result=run_contract(agent,canonical(binding),lambda:True); outcome={'result':'SUCCEEDED','records':len(result['records'])}
  except Exception as error:
   outcome={'result':'REFUSED','exception':type(error).__name__,'missing_key':error.args[0] if isinstance(error,KeyError) else None}
  finally: sys.setprofile(prior)
  results.append({'pin':'current4a3606' if current else 'legacy717','format':'compact' if compact else 'inline','assignment':'ACCEPTED','state_terminal':state.terminal,'counts':counts,**outcome})
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
assert all(x['result']=='SUCCEEDED' for x in results if x['format']=='inline')
assert all(x['exception']=='KeyError' and x['missing_key']=='prompt_bundle' and x['counts']=={'reads':1,'pure':2,'task_result':0} for x in results if x['format']=='compact')
